notes_for_operator: We assumed 4 AAPI-owned vendors on the hall. Confirm count + names before May 1.
Mother's Day pre-fixe pricing wasn't in the brief. Add to brand_profile.signature_offerings once confirmed.
Grill class at $65 is a placeholder — confirm with the chef teaching it.
Review-spotlight slot needs a recent review with a first name + one-line quote. If none qualifies, swap to a behind-the-scenes post for that day.
WhatsApp broadcast: ChefScape's audience isn't a WhatsApp-broadcast-native list (unlike our default desi clients). We're skipping the WhatsApp asset for this client unless the operator asks.
